mapper.select: SELECT request_id, request_sha256, status, device_id, actual_id, code, hardware_serial, plugin_id, codec_id, binding_version, device_created_at FROM device_onboarding_request WHERE requested_by = #{requestedBy} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_onboarding_request(request_id, tenant_id, requested_by, idempotency_key, request_sha256, status, requested_at) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{tenantId}, #{requestedBy}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestSha256}, 'PROCESSING', #{requestedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, requested_by, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE device_onboarding_request SET status = 'COMPLETED', device_id = #{deviceId}, actual_id = #{actualId}, code = #{code}, hardware_serial = #{hardwareSerial}, plugin_id = #{pluginId}, codec_id = #{codecId}, binding_version = #{bindingVersion}, device_created_at = #{deviceCreatedAt}, completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
